operations.title: Homology descent is strictly weaker than a physical chain map
operations.statement: A graded map S induces H_n(G)->H_n(H) exactly when Omega_n vanishes on Z_n(G) and Omega_(n+1)(C_(n+1)(G)) lies in B_n(H). These conditions can hold with Omega nonzero.

operations.title: Contractible-summand separation of homology descent from chain compatibility
operations.outcome: Omega_1=diag(-1,0) is nonzero, but S induces the identity on the surviving homology summand.
operations.falsifier: This falsifies the inference that failure of strict chain compatibility necessarily destroys every class-level readout.
